en.actionable: A labour-policy analyst responsible for older-worker hiring:within two weeks,choose a country where pension age has just changed and compare employment in the two age bands around the old pension age,stating whether family workers are included;read next (linked to “Leading indicator”):the BLS 65-plus monthly series,Japan’s 65-69 rate,UK employment at age 66,and qualifying China or EU counts;Use the selected country’s two comparable age bands first;counts from other countries are context only.
en.audience: The impact reach includes the 65+ populations of the G7,China,India and other countries,a constructed hundred-millions-scale reach that is not counted in the denominator;the actual repeated actors are people aged 65+ who worked at least one hour for pay in the reference week - under the frozen measure the qualifying sum lies between about 10.29 million and 51.64 million,tens-of-millions-scale;Japan's 65-69 group is above half on the published figure,unverified after family workers are subtracted. It mainly neither raises existing professionals' ceiling nor lets people who could not do it do it now;it lets people who are already working delay their exit.
en.falsifier: Any one of the following falsifies the corresponding part of this card:(1) in the latest annual data available before 2030-10-10,the sum for the same seven countries and the same series is ≥ 100 million (overturns “still below 100 million”);(2) the sum for the same fixed panel is below the about 51.64 million registered on this card (overturns “rises”);(3) in any year within the window,the employment rate of Japan's 65-69 group on the published figure is below 50% (overturns the “stays at 50% or above” item of the forward claim;this published figure includes family workers and does not carry the current D-tier verdict);(4) a new component appears,with a reference period between 2023-01-01 and 2026-10-10,that qualifies under the frozen rules (for example a count of employed people aged 65+ for China or the EU) and brings the sum of qualifying components to ≥ 100 million (overturns the C verdict of the “Current-scale review” - this is an overturn by measurement coverage,not behavioural expansion,and must be recorded separately from (1)). If any country's definition changes,it is recorded only as a definitional change and may not count as a hit.
en.judgment: As of 2026-10-10,“aged 65 or over and working at least one hour for pay in the reference week” reaches only the D tier (segment diffusion) under the definitions frozen in advance:the components of the seven countries that can be counted sum to about 51.64 million before unpaid family helpers are subtracted,which is an upper bound on the qualifying sum;the subtraction the freeze requires was not carried out this round,and the lower bound derived from Japan and South Korea is about 10.29 million,so the qualifying sum lies in the tens of millions,short of hundred-million weekly reach (the EU,China,Brazil,Indonesia and Mexico count as 0 under the rules);through 2030-10-10,the sum for the same seven-country panel rises but stays below 100 million,and the employment rate of Japan's 65-69 group,on the published figure,stays at 50% or above.
en.leading_indicator: The US BLS monthly series of employed people aged 65+ (LNU02000097);the employment rate of 65-69-year-olds in the Labour Force Survey of Japan's Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications;the employment rate of 66-year-olds in the UK while the State Pension age rises to 67;whether China's National Bureau of Statistics starts publishing counts of employed people aged 65+;Eurostat's count of employed people aged 65+;annually.
en.lens: This card does not invoke **L10**:the step “raising the pension age falls on cohorts not yet drawing,and is therefore within reach” is **carried by no lens in L1-L9** (L10's unit is a whole public arrangement,and it does not judge sub-cohorts inside a pension;see the Lens field of the preceding judgment);the step “a later pension age makes more people keep working after 65” is **carried by no lens in L1-L9** (it is a labour-supply response to income rules,and the mapping table has no lens that carries it);this card starts from a frozen countable action,not from “what becomes abundant”,and does not invoke **L1** (codes in Methodology §2).
en.opposing_mechanism: Coverage is the biggest risk:China has about 99 million employed people aged 60+,and as soon as its statistical agency publishes a qualifying 65+ figure,the C verdict of the current-scale review could flip to A,triggering falsifier (4) - half of this card's D tier comes from “no figure”. The second opposing mechanism:the rise comes mainly from population ageing itself,not from the fiscal squeeze,so even if this card's forward claim hits,it cannot be taken as evidence for the preceding judgment's mechanism. The third:a recession pushes older workers out first (as in 2020),and the fixed-panel sum could fall back below 51.64 million.
en.reasoning_chain: The fiscal squeeze leads countries to raise the age at which the public pension can be drawn,and this cut falls on cohorts not yet drawing (the preceding judgment,carried by no lens) → income breaks off after the old pension age,and some people keep working every week (carried by no lens) → counted once under the frozen measure:about 51.64 million across seven countries before unpaid family helpers are subtracted,and a lower bound of about 10.29 million derived from Japan and South Korea (Gate 1 fails;the D-tier sum route holds on the lower bound) → legislated increases keep taking effect in 2026-2030,and the 65+ population keeps growing → the fixed-panel sum rises,but going from about 52 million to 100 million would need almost a doubling,which cannot happen in four years → within the window it stays at the D tier.

zh.actionable: 负责 65 岁以上招聘的劳动力政策分析师:两周内选一个领取年龄刚变化的国家,比较旧领取年龄前后两个年龄组的就业率,并注明是否含家族从业者;看什么(挂在「领先指标」):BLS 65 岁以上月度人数、日本 65-69 岁就业率、英国 66 岁就业率及中国/欧盟合格人数;先看所选国家两个年龄组的可比样本,其他国家人数只作背景。
zh.audience: 影响面包括七国集团与中、印等国的 65 岁以上人口,构造式亿量级,不计入分母;实际重复执行者为参照周内为报酬至少工作 1 小时的 65 岁以上者,按冻结口径的合格合计在约 1,029 万至 5,164 万之间,属千万量级;日本 65-69 岁组按公布值过半,扣除家族从业者后未核实。它主要既不是提高既有专业者上限,也不是让原本不会的人也能做,而是让已有的劳动者推迟退出。
zh.falsifier: 以下任一条成立,即证伪本卡对应的那一部分:(1) 2030-10-10 前可得的最新年度数据中,同一七国、同一序列的合计 ≥ 1 亿(推翻「仍低于 1 亿」);(2) 同一固定面板的合计低于本卡登记的约 5,164 万(推翻「上升」);(3) 窗口内任一年度,日本 65-69 岁组按公布值的就业率低于 50%(推翻前瞻里「保持在 50% 以上」一项;这个公布值含家族从业者,不承担现时的 D 档判定);(4) 出现参照期在 2023-01-01 至 2026-10-10 之间、按冻结规则合格的新分量(例如中国或欧盟的 65 岁以上就业人数),使合格分量之和 ≥ 1 亿(推翻「现时规模复核」的 C 判定--这是测量覆盖的推翻,不是行为扩张,须与 (1) 分开记录)。任一国口径改变时,只登记为口径变化,不据此判命中。
zh.judgment: 截至 2026-10-10,「年满 65 岁、在参照周内为报酬至少工作 1 小时」按事先冻结的口径只到 D 档(分众普及):可计入的七国分量在扣除无酬家庭帮工之前合计约 5,164 万,这是合格合计的上界;冻结要求的扣除本轮没有执行,按日本、韩国两国推出的下界约 1,029 万,合格合计落在千万级,达不到亿级周频(欧盟、中国、巴西、印尼、墨西哥按规则记 0);到 2030-10-10,同一七国面板的合计上升但仍低于 1 亿,日本 65-69 岁组按公布值的就业率保持在 50% 以上。
zh.leading_indicator: 美国 BLS 65 岁以上就业人数月度序列(LNU02000097);日本总务省劳动力调查的 65-69 岁就业率;英国 66 岁人群在国家养老金领取年龄升到 67 岁期间的就业率;中国国家统计局是否开始公布 65 岁以上就业人数;欧盟统计局 65 岁以上就业人数;每年。
zh.lens: 本卡不调用 **L10**:「提高领取年龄落在尚未领取的队列身上、因而可达」这一步 **L1-L9 中无承载透镜**(L10 的单位是整个公共安排,不判养老金内部的子队列,见 the preceding judgment 的透镜字段);「领取年龄推后会让更多人在 65 岁以后继续工作」这一步 **L1-L9 中无承载透镜**(属劳动供给对收入规则的反应,映射表没有承载它的透镜);本卡从一个冻结的可数动作起步,不从「什么变丰富」起步,未调用 **L1**(代号定义见方法论 §2)。
zh.opposing_mechanism: 覆盖率才是最大的风险:中国 60 岁以上就业者约 9,900 万,只要统计机构公布一个合格的 65 岁以上数字,现时复核的 C 判定就可能翻成 A,证伪条件 (4) 随之触发--本卡的 D 档有一半来自「没有数字」。第二条反方:上升主要来自人口老化本身,而不是财政挤压,本卡的前瞻即使命中,也不能当作 the preceding judgment 机制的证据。第三条:经济衰退会先把老年劳动者挤出(2020 年即如此),固定面板合计可能跌回 5,164 万以下。
zh.reasoning_chain: 财政挤压让各国推后公共养老金的领取年龄,这一刀落在尚未领取的队列身上(the preceding judgment,无承载)→ 收入在旧领取年龄之后断档,一部分人继续每周工作(无承载)→ 按冻结口径数一次:七国未扣除无酬家庭帮工的合计约 5,164 万,按日本、韩国推出的下界约 1,029 万(闸一不过,D 档合计路径按下界成立)→ 已立法的推后在 2026-2030 年继续生效,65 岁以上人口继续增长 → 固定面板合计上升,但从约 5,200 万到 1 亿需要几乎翻倍,四年内到不了 → 窗口内停在 D 档。

en.actionable: A general-purpose AI product lead:within two weeks,classify 30 real user requests as asking or handing off a low-consequence task versus delegated ordering and payment,and add source,checking,and correction paths to the first group;read next (linked to “Leading indicator”):weekly active and paid users,free-tier limits,survey-based weekly use,and any published weekly delegated-payment count;Use the 30 requests first for classification and correction outcomes;platform totals are context only.
en.audience: The impact reach includes internet users who passively see AI summaries on search pages,a constructed billion-scale reach that is not counted in the denominator;the actual repeated actors are de-duplicated individuals who,at least once in 7 days,on their own initiative ask a general-purpose AI chat assistant a question or hand it a task - a single service’s self-reported lower bound is above 900 million,hundred-millions-scale (the S-tier threshold is 100 million;the lower bound is self-reported and unaudited,and services may not be added together). It mainly lets people who could not do it do it now:more than seven in ten messages are non-work,and the top three uses are practical guidance,seeking information,and writing;it also raises existing professionals' ceiling,but that is not where the scale comes from.
en.falsifier: Any one of the following falsifies the corresponding part of this card:(1) before 2029-10-10,any platform publicly reports at least 100 million de-duplicated weekly users who order or pay through an AI on their behalf (overturns “delegated payment does not reach a hundred million weekly in the window”);(2) evidence independent of the providers - an audit,a regulatory disclosure,or a survey with a stated sampling design multiplied by a citable population base - shows that every single service’s de-duplicated weekly denominator was below 100 million at T (overturns “the S tier was reached at T”);(3) within the window,one of the three largest general-purpose chat assistants removes its free tier,and its publicly reported weekly active users are still at least 100 million a year after removal (overturns “the free tier is a necessary premise”;if no service removes its free tier within the window,this item is recorded as undeterminable,not as passed);(4) with the free tier still in place,every qualifying measure falls below 100 million by 2029-10-10 (overturns “it stays at the S tier”).
en.judgment: As of 2026-10-10,“on one’s own initiative,asking a general-purpose AI chat assistant a question or handing it a task” has reached the S tier (a single service self-reports more than 900 million weekly active users;the lower bound is self-reported and unaudited);as long as the free tier exists,it stays above a hundred million people weekly through 2029-10-10;while “handing a purchase or booking to an AI to place and pay for” does not reach a hundred million people weekly in the same window - what has reached society scale is asking and handing off low-stakes tasks,not deciding for people and not paying for them.
en.leading_indicator: Providers’ published weekly active users and consumer-subscriber counts (if a single service’s paying users reach 100 million,the free tier stops being a necessary premise and this card must be rewritten);changes to free-tier terms (quotas,ads,removal);survey shares for “used in the past week” with stated sampling designs,plus citable population bases;whether any platform starts publishing de-duplicated weekly users of AI ordering/payment on someone’s behalf;search-query series independent of the providers;annually.
en.lens: Diffusion lag (**L4**:“can be done” is not the same as being adopted;used to turn a direction into a time window - this card’s three-year window and free-tier premise),cost structure (**L3**:the free tier is sustained by cross-subsidy from subscription,enterprise,and API revenue,which is a matter of product bundling),human nature and demand (**L8**:the “certainty” and “accountability” anchors confine the society-scale action to the asking side;this card does not require human nature to change). This card starts from a frozen countable action,not from “what becomes abundant”,and does not invoke **L1** (codes in Methodology §2).
en.opposing_mechanism: A capital pullback:if returns on training and inference investment disappoint,providers narrow or remove the free tier,or load it with ads and strict quotas,and weekly users could fall back to a tens-of-millions paying population - exactly the path along which this card’s necessary premise is deleted. Another opposing mechanism comes from the other direction:operating-system and payment platforms make AI ordering a default entry point (one-tap authorisation,revocable by default),so delegated payment crosses a hundred million weekly within three years,and the part of this card about delegated payment fails.
en.reasoning_chain: The need to find answers and to get help writing something predates AI,and searching and asking people are its old actions (L8;no change in human nature required) → general-purpose chat assistants enter phones and browsers that are already ubiquitous through a free tier,and adoption needs no one else to change at the same time (Gates 3 and 4) → one question replaces one search or one request to a person,and voluntary repeat use rose through 2023-2026 (self-reported weekly users 100 million → more than 900 million) → but answers can be wrong,and anything with consequences needs someone accountable (L8’s “certainty” and “accountability”) → the society-scale action stops at asking and handing off low-stakes tasks;deciding (the preceding judgment) and ordering-and-paying on someone’s behalf need authorisation,revocation,and a liable party (the preceding judgment),and neither clears Gate 1 at T → the necessary premise of the scale is the free tier:counting payers only gives a self-reported lower bound above 59 million at T and,at a paying share of about 5 percent,stays in the tens of millions,which would drop the result to the D tier.

zh.actionable: 通用 AI 产品负责人:两周内从 30 条真实用户请求中区分「提问/交办低后果任务」和「代下单付款」,为前一类加上、核对和纠错入口;看什么(挂在「领先指标」):周活与付费人数、免费档额度变化、调查周使用率及平台公开的代付款周频人数;先看这 30 条请求的分类与纠错结果,平台总量只作背景。
zh.audience: 影响面包括被动看到搜索页 AI 摘要的上网人口,构造式十亿量级,不计入分母;实际重复执行者为 7 天内至少一次主动向通用 AI 对话助手提问或交办任务的去重个人,单一服务自报下限超 9 亿,属亿量级(S 档门槛为 1 亿;下限来自自报、未审计,跨服务不得相加)。主要是让原本不会的人也能做:非工作消息占七成以上,前三类用途是实用指导、查信息与写作;它也提高既有专业者上限,但后者不是规模的来源。
zh.falsifier: 以下任一条成立,即证伪本卡对应的那一部分:(1) 2029-10-10 之前,任一平台公开报告「每周代下单或代付款的去重用户」≥ 1 亿(推翻「代付在窗口内达不到亿级周频」);(2) 出现独立于服务方的证据--审计、监管披露,或有抽样说明的调查乘以可引用的人口基数--显示 T 时任一单一服务的去重周分母都低于 1 亿(推翻「T 时已达 S 档」);(3) 窗口内前三大通用对话助手之一取消免费档,取消满一年时该服务公开的周活仍 ≥ 1 亿(推翻「免费档是必要前提」;窗口内若没有任何服务取消免费档,此条记为不可判定,不记为通过);(4) 免费档仍在的情况下,到 2029-10-10 所有合格口径都跌破 1 亿(推翻「仍停在 S 档」)。
zh.judgment: 截至 2026-10-10,「本人主动向通用 AI 对话助手提问或交办一项任务」已达 S 档(单一服务自报周活超 9 亿,下限来自自报、未审计);只要免费档仍在,到 2029-10-10 它仍停在亿级周频之上;而「把一次购物或订票交给 AI 代为下单付款」在同一窗口内达不到亿级周频--达到社会级的是「问」和交办低后果任务,不是替人拍板,也不是替人付钱。
zh.leading_indicator: 服务方公开的周活与付费消费者订阅者人数(若单一服务的付费者达到 1 亿,免费档不再是必要前提,本卡须改写);免费档条款的变化(额度、广告、取消);有抽样说明的「过去一周使用过」调查比例及可引用的人口基数;平台是否开始公开代下单/代付款的每周去重用户;独立于服务方的搜索查询量序列;每年。
zh.lens: 扩散滞后(**L4**:「能做」不等于被采用,用于把方向变成时间窗--本卡的三年窗口与免费档前提)、成本结构(**L3**:免费档靠订阅、企业与 API 收入交叉补贴维持,属产品打包方式)、人性与需求(**L8**:「确定性」与「责任归属」两个锚把社会级动作限定在「问」一侧;本卡不要求人性改变)。本卡从一个冻结的可数动作起步,不从「什么变丰富」起步,未调用 **L1**(代号定义见方法论 §2)。
zh.opposing_mechanism: 资本退潮:训练与推理投入回报不及预期时,服务方收窄或取消免费档,或在免费档插入广告与严格额度,周活可能退回千万级的付费人群--这正是本卡的必要前提被删去的路径。另一条反方来自相反方向:操作系统与支付平台把代下单做成默认入口(一键授权、默认可撤回),使代付在三年内越过亿级周频,本卡关于「代付」的那一部分随即失效。
zh.reasoning_chain: 找答案、找人帮忙写东西的需求早于 AI 存在,搜索与问人是它的旧动作(L8,不要求人性改变)→ 通用对话助手以免费档进入早已普及的手机与浏览器,采用不需要任何他人同时改变(闸三、闸四)→ 一次提问替代一次搜索或一次求人,自愿重复使用在 2023-2026 年持续上升(自报周活 1 亿→超 9 亿)→ 但答案可能出错,有后果的事需要有人负责(L8 的「确定性」与「责任归属」)→ 社会级的动作停在「问」和交办低后果任务;拍板(the preceding judgment)与代下单付款需要授权、撤回与责任承接(the preceding judgment),在 T 时都过不了闸一 → 规模的必要前提是免费档:只数付费者,T 时自报下限超过 5,900 万,按约 5% 的付费比例停在千万级,结果会落到 D 档。

en.actionable: An NGO finance lead dependent on European official aid:within two weeks,list each project’s expected ODA for the next 12 months beside private-foundation,multilateral-loan,and recipient-government alternatives;read next (linked to “Leading indicator”):annual ODA and defence allocations,OECD preliminary data,refugee spending inside ODA,and the UK fiscal tests;Use the 12-month project substitution table first;annual aid totals are context only.
en.audience: The impact reach is the people in recipient countries who depend on aid programmes,a constructed hundred-millions-scale reach (head counts not verified this round);they do not vote in the donor countries and are not counted in any denominator;this card judges the budget behaviour of four countries,not an individual action,and the direct deciders are the four countries' governments and parliaments. It mainly neither raises existing professionals' ceiling nor lets people who could not do it do it now;it judges whether a line of foreign spending gives way to defence.
en.falsifier: Any one of the following falsifies this card:(1) the latest OECD data for 2028 available before 2029-12-31 (grant-equivalent measure) show that the ODA share of gross national income of any of the UK,France or Germany is not below its 2023 level;(2) the UK's 2028 ODA share is above 0.35%;(3) Italy's 2028 ODA share is above 0.35%;(4) data from the same NATO edition show that the 2028 core defence share of any of the UK,France or Germany is not above its 2023 level - if defence also falls back,the mechanism “aid gives way to defence” does not hold,even if aid stays low. The 2023 baseline is the revised 2023 value in the latest edition at the time of the check;if the revision exceeds 0.05 percentage points,record the revision and judge against the new baseline.
en.judgment: Checked against 2028 data published in 2029,official development assistance (ODA) as a share of gross national income in the UK,France and Germany is in each case still below its own 2023 level (0.58%,0.50%,0.79%),and core defence spending as a share of GDP is in each case still above its own 2023 level (NATO 2026 edition:2.22%,1.88%,1.60%);the ODA shares of the UK and Italy are both no higher than 0.35% - the budget with no domestic periodic recipients is squeezed out first,and it does not swing back within the window.
en.leading_indicator: ODA and defence appropriations in each country's annual budget;the OECD's preliminary ODA data,released each April;NATO's annual defence expenditure report and the annual paths submitted by each country;the share of ODA spent on refugees inside donor countries;whether the UK's two fiscal tests for returning to 0.7% are met;annually.
en.lens: L10 is mentioned only as historical context;it was withdrawn on 2026-10-10 after the estate-tax counterexample. The “within reach” step is now carried by no lens in L1-L9;conclusion,,,time window and falsifier are unchanged. NATO's target enters only as a signed budget requirement,and this card invokes no reasoning about geopolitics;**L1** is not invoked (codes in Methodology §2).
en.opposing_mechanism: Aid can be redefined instead of cut:counting more refugee reception,stabilisation or aid to Ukraine as ODA lifts the ODA share without more money reaching recipient countries - this would falsify the card's numbers without overturning its mechanism,and must be noted separately when due. The second opposing mechanism:the 2029 NATO review lowers the target,or a recession slows the defence path,while a new government again treats aid as a tool of foreign policy,and a country like Germany,long above 0.7%,returns to its 2023 level.
en.reasoning_chain: At the Hague summit in June 2025,NATO agreed on core defence of at least 3.5%,and 5% in total,by 2035,with paths submitted every year and a review in 2029 → the core defence shares of all four countries rose from 2023 to 2026 → raising taxes and cutting domestic benefit programmes both meet defenders → aid has no one in the donor country who draws it on a recurring basis (formerly the L10 veto direction:within reach;now carried by no lens in L1-L9) → the UK cut twice (2020:0.7% → 0.5%;2025:announced 0.5% → 0.3%,explicitly for defence),the preliminary 2025 data for France and Germany are already below 2023,and the DAC total fell to 0.26% in 2025 → no domestic defender pulls it back,and the 2028 data are still below 2023 (carried by no lens:L10 says nothing about timing or about whether a cut swings back;this step rests only on the 2020-2025 budget record). Italy's ODA was low to begin with (0.27% in 2023) and rose slightly in 2025;this card judges only that it does not exceed 0.35%.

zh.actionable: 依赖欧洲官方援助的 NGO 财务负责人:两周内把未来 12 个月每个项目的 ODA 预期、私人基金、多边贷款和受援国配套资金列成替代来源表;看什么(挂在「领先指标」):年度 ODA 与国防拨款、OECD 初步数据、难民开支占 ODA 比例和英国财政测试;先看这 12 个月项目替代来源表,年度援助总量只作背景。
zh.audience: 影响面是受援国中依赖援助项目的人,构造式亿量级(本轮未核实人数),他们不在援助国投票,不计入任何分母;本卡判断的是四国的预算行为,不是个人动作,直接决定者是四国政府与议会。它主要既不是提高既有专业者上限,也不是让原本不会的人也能做,而是判断一笔对外支出会不会让位于国防。
zh.falsifier: 以下任一条成立,即证伪本卡:(1) 2029-12-31 前可得的最新 OECD 2028 年数据(赠款等值口径)显示英、法、德任一国 ODA 占国民总收入比重不低于其 2023 年水平;(2) 英国 2028 年 ODA 占比高于 0.35%;(3) 意大利 2028 年 ODA 占比高于 0.35%;(4) 北约同一版次的数据显示英、法、德任一国 2028 年核心国防占比不高于其 2023 年水平--国防若也回落,「」的机制不成立,即使援外仍低。2023 年基准取复核时最新版次对 2023 年的修订值;修订超过 0.05 个百分点时,记录修订并按新基准判。
zh.judgment: 按 2029 年发布的 2028 年数据复核,英、法、德三国的官方发展援助(ODA)占国民总收入比重都仍低于各自 2023 年水平(0.58%、0.50%、0.79%),核心国防开支占 GDP 比重都仍高于各自 2023 年水平(北约 2026 年版:2.22%、1.88%、1.60%);英国与意大利的 ODA 占比都不高于 0.35%--没有国内按期领取者的预算先被挤出,而且在窗口内不回摆。
zh.leading_indicator: 各国年度预算中的 ODA 拨款与国防拨款;OECD 每年 4 月发布的初步 ODA 数据;北约每年的国防开支报告与各国提交的年度路径;援助国境内难民开支占 ODA 的比重;英国恢复 0.7% 的两项财政测试是否满足;每年。
zh.lens: L10 仅作为历史上下文提及,已于 2026-10-10 因美国联邦遗产税反例撤出工具箱。「可达」这一步现为 L1-L9 中无承载透镜;结论、、、时间窗、证伪条件不变。北约目标只作为一笔已签署的预算要求进入,本卡不调用任何关于地缘政治的推理;未调用 **L1**(代号定义见方法论 §2)。
zh.opposing_mechanism: 援外可以被重新定义而不是被削减:把难民接待、维稳或对乌克兰的援助更多地计入 ODA,ODA 占比回升,流到受援国的钱却没有变多--这会让本卡的数字被证伪而机制没有被推翻,到期时须单列说明。第二条反方:2029 年北约复核下调目标、或经济衰退放缓国防路径,同时新政府把援外重新当作外交工具,德国这样长期高于 0.7% 的国家回到 2023 年水平。
zh.reasoning_chain: 北约 2025 年 6 月海牙峰会同意到 2035 年核心国防至少 3.5%、合计 5%,每年提交路径,2029 年复核 → 四国核心国防占比 2023-2026 年全部上升 → 加税与削减国内领取项目都会遇到捍卫者 → 援外在援助国国内没有按周期领取的人(原 L10 否决向:可达;现为 L1-L9 中无承载)→ 英国两次削减(2020 年 0.7%→0.5%;2025 年宣布 0.5%→0.3%,明言用于国防),法、德 2025 年初步数据已低于 2023 年,DAC 合计 2025 年降到 0.26% → 没有国内捍卫者把它拉回,到 2028 年数据仍低于 2023 年(无承载:L10 不判时机,也不判削减后会不会回摆;这一步只靠 2020-2025 年的预算记录)。意大利的 ODA 本就低(2023 年 0.27%),2025 年略升,本卡只判它不超过 0.35%。

en.actionable: A pension-insurance product lead:within two weeks,code every current pension proposal in the country by its treatment of current nominal benefits,pension age,thresholds,taxation,and indexation;read next (linked to “Leading indicator”):the OASI exhaustion year,actuary benefit-saving split,budget freeze clauses,sovereign yields,and assistance;Use the country’s coded proposal table first;OASI and other external forecasts are context only.
en.audience: The impact reach includes current recipients of public pensions in the G7 and working contributors who are not yet drawing,a constructed hundred-millions-scale reach (estimated from each country's population structure;head counts were not verified country by country this round),not counted in the denominator of any weekly action;this card judges legislative and budget behaviour,not an individual action,and the direct deciders are the legislatures and governments of the seven countries. It mainly neither raises existing professionals' ceiling nor lets people who could not do it do it now;it judges whether an income already promised will be cut in nominal terms,and on which generation the burden of a cut falls.
en.falsifier: Any one of the following falsifies the corresponding part of this card:(1) within the window,any G7 country (the US,Japan,Germany,the UK,France,Italy,Canada) that,at the time of legislating,can borrow on the market and is not in a creditor assistance programme passes new legislation that brings the monthly nominal amount of the median current recipient's basic public pension below the previous period - an indexation formula written in by new legislation and triggered within the window also counts;written in advance as **not counting**:automatic rules already in force at T (the Japan fiscal 2022 kind),cuts that apply only to high pensions (the Italy 2019 kind),and tax changes;(2) within the window,US Social Security retirement beneficiaries are paid less than the amount due under law,or are paid late,because a trust fund is depleted - congressional **inaction** counts too;(3) a Social Security solvency bill passed in the US within the window contains a provision cutting the nominal monthly benefits of people already drawing;(4) for a solvency bill passed in the US within the window,the scoring by the Social Security Administration's Chief Actuary shows that more than half of the long-term benefit-side savings come from people already drawing at the time of enactment (if the scoring has no such breakdown,this item is recorded as undeterminable,not as passed). At the due check,it must be recorded truthfully whether any G7 member lost market financing or entered a creditor programme within the window;this exclusion may not be used as an excuse after the fact.
en.judgment: From 2026-10-10 to 2034-12-31,no G7 country that can still borrow on the market and is not in a creditor assistance programme passes new legislation that lowers the nominal amount of the median current recipient's basic public pension;the US Old-Age and Survivors Insurance (OASI) trust fund is projected to be depleted in the fourth quarter of 2032,this gap will not be resolved in a way that leaves people already drawing with less than the amount due under law,and at least half of the long-term benefit-side savings of any fix come from people who have not yet started drawing at the time of enactment.
en.leading_indicator: The depletion year and payable share in the annual US Social Security Trustees Report;solvency bills introduced in Congress and the Chief Actuary's scoring;pension indexation provisions and freeze proposals in the annual budgets of the seven countries;each country's long-term government bond yields and sovereign rating actions;whether any G7 member applies for external assistance;annually.
en.lens: This card does not invoke **L10** (constituency lock-in):its unit is a whole public arrangement,and the pension,as an arrangement,has people who draw it every month;its own calibration case,the 2005 US Social Security personal-accounts proposal,touched only cohorts under 55,yet it is still coded “has defenders”,and it failed. So the step “raising the pension age and changing future formulas falls on cohorts not yet drawing,and is therefore the first cut within reach” is **carried by no lens in L1-L9**,and rests only on the narrative precedents in C13 section 2;the step “current recipients' nominal amounts are the hardest to cut” is **carried by no lens in L1-L9** (L10's own text says only that when such a group exists,outright repeal will meet defenders,“not that the arrangement will survive”);the asymmetry in which nominal cuts are visible and real erosion is not is **carried by no lens in L1-L9 (the human-nature clause “loss aversion” has a source sentence)**;**L1** is not invoked (codes in Methodology §2).
en.opposing_mechanism: The bond market can rewrite the order overnight:if a large country suddenly loses market financing within the window,it lands on the Greek and Portuguese side,and nominal cuts come within reach - this card writes that case as an exclusion,so in the most dangerous situation it makes no judgment,and that is its cost. The second opposing mechanism is US deadlock:Congress does nothing before 2032,the Antideficiency Act leaves the Social Security Administration without authority to pay in full and on time,and what current recipients actually receive is held to about 78% by the income limit (the law writes no automatic cut rule;it only forbids paying more than the trust fund holds,78% is what income can pay,and recipients keep their legal entitlement to full benefits) - this is exactly falsifier (2);this card judges that it will not happen,but no lens carries that judgment.
en.reasoning_chain: Three bills - interest,ageing and defence - land on the same budget at once (US net interest exceeded defence in fiscal 2024 and 2025;OASI depleted in Q4 2032;NATO core defence of 3.5% by 2035) → tax increases have a ceiling,so some spending must give up share → raising the pension age and changing future formulas falls on cohorts not yet drawing,and is the most common cut in the precedents (carried by no lens:L10's unit is the whole arrangement,and it does not judge sub-cohorts inside a pension;the precedents are the US in 1983,France in 2023 and China in 2024;Canada announced it in its 2012 budget and reversed it in 2016,and the 2005 US personal-accounts proposal,which touched only people under 55,still failed,which shows it is within reach but does not necessarily stick) → for current recipients,countries that can finance themselves switch to methods that never appear in a notification letter:threshold freezes (UK 2022),taxation of benefits and delayed adjustments (US 1983),and automatic formulas written before T (Japan,fiscal 2022,nominal -0.4%);freezes proposed by governments also get deleted by parliaments (France 2026) - a nominal cut needs a visible vote (carried by no lens;the human-nature clause “loss aversion” has a source sentence) → nominal cuts by new legislation appear only in countries that have lost market financing and entered a creditor programme (Greece,Portugal;Ireland,also in a programme,did not cut the weekly rate of the State Pension in its 2011 budget either),or target only high pensions (Italy 2019) → so within the window,the US OASI gap will be resolved without cutting what current recipients are actually paid,and at least half of the long-term benefit-side savings of the fix come from people not yet drawing (carried by no lens,which is why is medium).

zh.actionable: 养老保险产品负责人:两周内把本国正在讨论的养老金方案按现领取者名义金额、领取年龄、门槛、计税和指数化逐项编码;看什么(挂在「领先指标」):OASI 耗尽年份、精算师福利节省分解、预算冻结条款、国债收益率与援助;先看本国方案编码表,OASI 等外部预测只作背景。
zh.audience: 影响面包括七国集团的公共养老金现领取者与尚未领取的在职缴费者,构造式亿量级(按各国人口结构估计,本轮未逐国核实人数),不计入任何周频动作的分母;本卡判断的是立法与预算行为,不是个人动作,直接决定者是七国的立法机构与政府。它主要既不是提高既有专业者上限,也不是让原本不会的人也能做,而是判断一笔已经承诺的收入会不会被名义削减、削减的负担落在哪一代人身上。
zh.falsifier: 以下任一条成立,即证伪本卡对应的那一部分:(1) 窗口内,七国集团(美、日、德、英、法、意、加)中任一在立法时既能在市场上融资、又未处于债权人援助计划的国家,通过新立法使中位现领取者的基本公共养老金月度名义金额低于前一期--新立法写入、并在窗口内触发的指数化公式同样计入;事先写明**不计入**:T 时已生效的自动规则(日本 2022 财年那类)、只适用于高额养老金的削减(意大利 2019 年那类)、税收变化;(2) 窗口内,美国社会保障退休金领取者因信托基金耗尽而实收低于法定应付,或被延迟支付--国会**不作为**同样计入;(3) 窗口内美国通过的社会保障偿付能力法案含有削减已在领取者名义月度福利的条款;(4) 窗口内美国通过的偿付能力法案,按社会保障署首席精算师的评分,福利侧长期节省有一半以上来自立法时已在领取的人(评分没有这种分解时,此条记为不可判定,不记为通过)。到期检查时须如实记录窗口内有没有七国成员失去市场融资或进入债权人计划,不得把这一排除条件当作事后借口。
zh.judgment: 2026-10-10 至 2034-12-31,在七国集团里,只要一个国家还能在市场上融资、没有进入债权人援助计划,就没有一国通过新立法让中位现领取者的基本公共养老金名义金额下降;美国老年与遗属保险信托基金(OASI)预计 2032 年第四季度耗尽,这一缺口的解决方式不会让已在领取的人实收低于法定应付,任何修补法案的福利侧长期节省至少一半来自立法时还没开始领取的人。
zh.leading_indicator: 美国社会保障年度受托人报告的耗尽年份与可支付比例;国会提交的偿付能力法案及首席精算师评分;七国年度预算中的养老金指数化条款与冻结提案;各国长期国债收益率与主权评级行动;是否有七国成员申请外部援助;每年。
zh.lens: 本卡不调用 **L10**(受益者锁定):它的单位是整个公共安排,而养老金这一安排有按月领取的人;它自己的校准案例 2005 年美国社会保障个人账户提案只动 55 岁以下的队列,仍被编码为「有捍卫者」并且失败。所以「提高领取年龄、改变未来公式落在尚未领取的队列身上,因而最先可达」这一步 **L1-L9 中无承载透镜**,只由 C13 第二节的叙事性先例支撑;「现领取者的名义金额最难动」这一步 **L1-L9 中无承载透镜**(L10 原文只说有这样的群体时整体废除会遇到捍卫者,「不说明它挺得过去」);名义削减可见、实际侵蚀不可见的不对称 **L1-L9 中无承载透镜(人性条文「损失厌恶」有源句)**;未调用 **L1**(代号定义见方法论 §2)。
zh.opposing_mechanism: 债券市场可以一夜改写排序:一个大国在窗口内突然失去市场融资,就落到希腊、葡萄牙那一侧,名义削减随之可达--本卡把这种情况写成排除条件,因而在最危险的情形下不作判断,这是它的代价。第二条反方是美国的僵局:国会在 2032 年前什么也不做,反超支法让社会保障署无权足额按时支付,现领取者的实收被收入上限压到约 78%(法律没有写自动削减规则,只禁止支付超过信托基金所有的钱,78% 是收入能付的上限,领取者对足额福利的法定权利仍在)--这正是证伪条件 (2),本卡判断它不会发生,但没有任何透镜承载这个判断。
zh.reasoning_chain: 利息、老龄化与国防三份账单同时落在同一本预算上(美国净利息 2024、2025 财年超过国防;OASI 2032 年第四季度耗尽;北约 2035 年核心国防 3.5%)→ 加税有上限,总要有支出让出份额 → 提高领取年龄、改变未来公式落在尚未领取的队列身上,是先例里最常见的一刀(无承载:L10 的单位是整个安排,不判养老金内部的子队列;先例为美国 1983、法国 2023、中国 2024;加拿大 2012 年预算宣布、2016 年撤回,美国 2005 年只动 55 岁以下者的个人账户提案仍然失败,说明可达但不一定站得住)→ 对现领取者,能自主融资的国家改用不写进通知信的办法:门槛冻结(英国 2022)、福利计税与推迟调整(美国 1983)、T 之前写好的自动公式(日本 2022 财年名义 -0.4%);政府提出的冻结也会被议会删掉(法国 2026)--名义削减需要一次看得见的投票(无承载,人性条文「损失厌恶」有源句)→ 新立法的名义削减只出现在失去市场融资、进入债权人计划的国家(希腊、葡萄牙;同在计划内的爱尔兰,2011 年预算也没有削国家养老金周额),或只针对高额养老金(意大利 2019)→ 所以窗口内,美国 OASI 缺口会以不削减现领取者实付的方式解决,修补的福利侧长期节省至少一半来自尚未领取的人(无承载,因此为中)。

en.actionable: A city-transport or workplace-policy lead:within two weeks,sample attendance rules from ten major employers and place them beside local remote-work rates,commuting trips,and office-use records;read next (linked to “Leading indicator”):employer attendance-day requirements,BLS or ONS remote-work rates,SWAA work-from-home days,and commuting trips;Use the ten employers’ rules and records first;national remote-work rates are context only.
en.audience: The impact reach includes commuter transport,office buildings and city-centre commerce,and is not counted in the denominator;the actual repeated actors are people at work who do at least part of their paid work at their own home in the reference week - the qualifying components of the US,the UK and New Zealand sum to about 48 million (broad definition;about 66 million with the EU added),tens-of-millions-scale,and the action is done by more than half of people at work within US standard breakdowns such as computer and mathematical,business and financial operations,and professional and technical services. It mainly neither raises existing professionals' ceiling nor lets people who could not do it do it now;it changes where people already employed do their work;the size of the small part that may belong to “lets people who could not do it do it now” (the telework rate of people at work with a disability is 24.4%,above the overall rate) was not measured.
en.falsifier: Any one of the following falsifies the corresponding part of this card:(1) over the most recent 12 months before 2029-10-10,the average telework rate in BLS’s Current Population Survey (people-at-work measure,Table A-41) is above 25% or below 19% (overturns “plateau”:the former is expansion,the latter contraction);(2) in any 12 consecutive months within the window,the average telework rate of BLS’s “computer and mathematical occupations” falls below 50% (overturns the continuation of the D-tier route “above half within a standard breakdown”);(3) a qualifying weekly survey with a reference period between 2023-01-01 and 2026-10-10 appears that brings the sum of qualifying components under the frozen rules to ≥ 100 million (overturns the C verdict of the “Current-scale review” - this is an overturn by measurement coverage,not behavioural expansion,and must be recorded separately from (1));(4) within the window the US or the UK legislates to let workers decide unilaterally to work from home (the employer may not refuse on business grounds),and one year after it takes effect that country’s telework share has still not risen out of its previous range (overturns “the employer’s decision right is a necessary premise”;if no such legislation occurs within the window,this item is recorded as undeterminable,not as passed).
en.judgment: As of 2026-10-10,“doing at least part of one’s paid work at one’s own home in the reference week” reaches only the D tier (segment diffusion) under the definitions frozen in advance:the qualifying components of the US,the UK and New Zealand sum to about 48 million (all broad definition;about 66 million with the EU added,whose base was not obtained),short of hundred-million weekly reach,and the action is done by more than half of people at work only within standard breakdowns such as the US computer and mathematical,and business and financial operations,occupation groups;through 2029-10-10 it stays on a plateau - the telework rate among US people at work neither expands above 25% nor falls back below 19%;whether people work at home is decided mainly by the employer,not by the person.
en.leading_indicator: The BLS Table A-41 monthly telework rate and the Table A-42 telework rates by occupation and by industry;the SWAA monthly series of the share of paid working days worked entirely at home;commuting trips per person in England's National Travel Survey;the ONS share who “worked from home in the past seven days”;the office-attendance-day requirements of major employers and governments and their enforcement;flexible-working legislation;whether national statistical agencies start publishing qualifying weekly working-from-home figures (Canada,Japan,China,India),and the EU employment base;annually.
en.lens: Human nature and demand (**L8**:the “sense of presence” and “real relationships” anchors keep the equilibrium at hybrid working;this card does not require human nature to change),cost structure (**L3**:employers set office days by the costs of coordination and supervision,so the decision lies with the organisation,not the individual),diffusion lag (**L4**:used to write the plateau as a time window). This card starts from a frozen countable action,not from “what becomes abundant”,and does not invoke **L1** (codes in Methodology §2).
en.opposing_mechanism: The white-collar tasks that can be done remotely are exactly the part most easily replaced by AI:if employment in these jobs contracts markedly within the window,the number of teleworkers falls below the lower edge of the range and the plateau ends in contraction - AI appears only in this opposing mechanism,not in this card’s mechanism;delete it and the card’s conclusion still holds. The second opposing mechanism comes from the employer side:an economic downturn raises employers’ bargaining power,office-attendance requirements spread from large employers to small and medium ones,and the telework rate falls below 19%. The third comes from the opposite direction:labour shortages and population ageing lead employers to use working from home as a recruiting chip,and the telework rate rises above 25%.
en.reasoning_chain: The demand to commute less and arrange one’s own time has long existed (L8;no change in human nature required) → home broadband and personal devices had long since become common for other reasons (Gate 3),and the forced shutdowns of 2020 gave employers their first large-scale test of working from home → workers value working from home as equivalent to a pay rise of about 8%,and voluntary repeat use held steady through 2023-2026 at more than three times the 2019 level (Gate 5) → but working from home needs the employer’s consent (Gate 4),and about four in ten people at work are in occupations that require being on site - service,construction,production,transportation - with telework rates of only 0.9%-12.8% (occupational structure) → so the scale stops at the tens of millions and is above half only in white-collar breakdowns (Gate 1 fails,D tier) → from 2025 the federal government and large employers tightened office-attendance requirements,and the telework rate moved sideways between 21.5% and 23.8% → within the window it stays on a plateau. AI is not part of this mechanism:delete AI and the conclusion holds unchanged.

zh.actionable: 城市交通或企业办公政策负责人:两周内抽取 10 家主要雇主的到岗规则,与本地远程率、通勤次数和办公室使用记录并列;看什么(挂在「领先指标」):雇主到岗天数要求、BLS/ONS 远程率、SWAA 在家工作日占比和通勤出行次数;先看这 10 家雇主的规则与记录,国家远程率只作背景。
zh.audience: 影响面包括通勤交通、写字楼与城市中心商业,不计入分母;实际重复执行者为参照周内至少一部分有酬工作在自己家里完成的在岗者,美、英、新三国合格分量合计约 4,800 万(口径偏宽;补上欧盟约 6,600 万),属千万量级,在美国计算机与数学、商业与金融运营、专业与技术服务等标准分组内过半。它主要既不是提高既有专业者上限,也不是让原本不会的人也能做,而是改变已就业者的工作地点;可能属于「让原本不会的人也能做」的那一小部分(有残障的在岗者远程率 24.4%,高于全体)规模未测。
zh.falsifier: 以下任一条成立,即证伪本卡对应的那一部分:(1) 2029-10-10 之前最近 12 个月,BLS 现时人口调查的远程率(在岗者口径,表 A-41)均值高于 25% 或低于 19%(推翻「平台期」:前者为扩张,后者为收缩);(2) 窗口内任一连续 12 个月,BLS「计算机与数学职业」远程率均值跌破 50%(推翻「标准分组内过半」这条 D 档路径的延续);(3) 出现参照期在 2023-01-01 至 2026-10-10 之间的合格周口径调查,使按冻结规则的合格分量之和 ≥ 1 亿(推翻「现时规模复核」的 C 判定--这是测量覆盖的推翻,不是行为扩张,须与 (1) 分开记录);(4) 美国或英国在窗口内立法让劳动者可以单方决定在家工作(雇主不得以业务理由拒绝),生效满一年后该国的远程比例仍未升出原区间(推翻「雇主决定权是必要前提」;窗口内若没有这种立法,此条记为不可判定,不记为通过)。
zh.judgment: 截至 2026-10-10,「参照周内至少一部分有酬工作在自己家里完成」按事先冻结的口径只到 D 档(分众普及):美、英、新三国合格分量合计约 4,800 万(全部口径偏宽;补上基数未取得的欧盟约 6,600 万),达不到亿级周频,只在美国计算机与数学、商业与金融运营等标准分组内过半;到 2029-10-10,它停在平台期--美国在岗者的远程率既不扩张出 25%,也不退回 19% 以下;在家与否主要由雇主决定,而不是由本人决定。
zh.leading_indicator: BLS 表 A-41 月度远程率与表 A-42 分职业、分行业远程率;SWAA 全天在家有酬工作日占比月度序列;英格兰全国出行调查的人均通勤出行次数;ONS「过去七天在家工作过」比例;主要雇主与政府的到岗天数要求及其执行;弹性工作立法;各国统计机构是否开始公布合格的周口径在家工作数字(加拿大、日本、中国、印度)以及欧盟就业基数;每年。
zh.lens: 人性与需求(**L8**:「在场感」与「真实关系」两个锚把均衡点停在混合办公,本卡不要求人性改变)、成本结构(**L3**:雇主按协调与监督成本决定到岗天数,决定权在组织而不在个人)、扩散滞后(**L4**:用于把平台期写成时间窗)。本卡从一个冻结的可数动作起步,不从「什么变丰富」起步,未调用 **L1**(代号定义见方法论 §2)。
zh.opposing_mechanism: 可远程完成的白领任务恰恰是最容易被 AI 替代的那一部分:若窗口内这些岗位的就业明显收缩,远程人数会跌破区间下沿,平台期以收缩告终--AI 只出现在这条反方里,不在本卡机制里,删去它,本卡结论仍成立。第二条反方来自雇主一侧:经济下行让雇主议价力上升,到岗要求从大雇主扩散到中小雇主,远程率跌破 19%。第三条来自相反方向:劳动力短缺与人口老化让雇主把在家工作当作招聘筹码,远程率升过 25%。
zh.reasoning_chain: 少通勤、自己安排时间的需求早已存在(L8,不要求人性改变)→ 家庭宽带与个人设备早已因别的理由普及(闸三),2020 年的强制停摆让雇主第一次大规模验证了在家办公 → 劳动者把在家工作等同于约 8% 的加薪,自愿重复使用在 2023-2026 年稳定在高于 2019 年三倍以上的水平(闸五)→ 但在家与否需要雇主同意(闸四),而约四成在岗者从事服务、建筑、生产、运输等必须到场的职业,远程率只有 0.9%-12.8%(职业结构)→ 所以规模停在千万级,只在白领分组内过半(闸一不过,D 档)→ 2025 年起联邦政府与大雇主收紧到岗要求,远程率在 21.5%-23.8% 之间横盘 → 窗口内停在平台期。AI 不在这条机制里:删去 AI,结论原样成立。
